ops.name: get_me
ops.title: My profile
ops.description: The user's level, XP, coins, energy and health, and the API limits.

ops.name: list_tasks
ops.title: List tasks
ops.description: A task or habit. Completing it gives XP to its skills; recurring ones come back every period. Oldest change first; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

ops.name: get_task
ops.title: Get a task
ops.description: One task by id.

ops.name: create_task
ops.title: Create a task
ops.description: A task or habit. Completing it gives XP to its skills; recurring ones come back every period. Returns it as stored.

icon.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png

energy_cost.description: Energy when completed: negative spends it (default -1)

anyOf.description: Only for tasks that are not recurring

deadline.description: Only for tasks that are not recurring

is_penalty.description: Missing the deadline takes XP away

skills.description: Every skill the task gives XP to (the whole list: missing ones are unlinked)

ops.name: update_task
ops.title: Update a task
ops.description: Changes only the fields sent.

icon.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png

energy_cost.description: Energy when completed: negative spends it (default -1)

anyOf.description: Only for tasks that are not recurring

deadline.description: Only for tasks that are not recurring

is_penalty.description: Missing the deadline takes XP away

skills.description: Every skill the task gives XP to (the whole list: missing ones are unlinked)

ops.name: delete_task
ops.title: Delete a task
ops.description: One-off tasks are deleted; recurring tasks are archived (their history stays), as the app does. Pact tasks and bad habits only change in the app.

ops.name: complete_task
ops.title: Complete a task
ops.description: Asks the app to complete the task: it applies it with its own rules (XP, coins, energy) on its next sync, usually within minutes. list_completions shows how it went.

completed_at.description: When it was done, within the last 7 days (default: now)

ops.name: list_completions
ops.title: Completion requests
ops.description: The completions asked through the API, newest first, and whether the app applied them.

ops.name: list_subtasks
ops.title: List subtasks
ops.description: A step in a task's checklist. Ticking every step does not complete the task: complete_task does. Recurring tasks untick their steps when the period changes. Oldest change first; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

ops.name: get_subtask
ops.title: Get a subtask
ops.description: One subtask by id.

ops.name: create_subtask
ops.title: Create a subtask
ops.description: A step in a task's checklist. Ticking every step does not complete the task: complete_task does. Recurring tasks untick their steps when the period changes. Returns it as stored.

task_id.description: The task it belongs to (only when creating)

ops.name: update_subtask
ops.title: Update a subtask
ops.description: Changes only the fields sent.

task_id.description: The task it belongs to (only when creating)

ops.name: delete_subtask
ops.title: Delete a subtask
ops.description: Removes the step from the checklist.

ops.name: list_skills
ops.title: List skills
ops.description: A skill the user levels up (Fitness, Reading…). Tasks give it XP when completed. Oldest change first; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

ops.name: get_skill
ops.title: Get a skill
ops.description: One skill by id.

ops.name: create_skill
ops.title: Create a skill
ops.description: A skill the user levels up (Fitness, Reading…). Tasks give it XP when completed. Returns it as stored.

icon.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png

is_active.description: Active skills show on the home screen

ops.name: update_skill
ops.title: Update a skill
ops.description: Changes only the fields sent.

icon.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png

is_active.description: Active skills show on the home screen

ops.name: delete_skill
ops.title: Delete a skill
ops.description: Skills are archived, never deleted: their history stays.

ops.name: list_categories
ops.title: List categories
ops.description: A list tasks are grouped in (read-only). Oldest change first; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

ops.name: get_category
ops.title: Get a category
ops.description: One category by id.

ops.name: list_history
ops.title: List history
ops.description: What happened: completions, level-ups, streaks (read-only, newest last). Oldest change first; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

ops.name: get_history_entry
ops.title: Get a history entry
ops.description: One history entry by id.

ops.name: list_routines
ops.title: List routines
ops.description: A time blocking routine («Workday», «Weekend»…): its blocks of the day and the weekdays it loads. Which routine a date loads: get_day. Oldest change first; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

ops.name: get_routine
ops.title: Get a routine
ops.description: One routine by id.

ops.name: create_routine
ops.title: Create a routine
ops.description: A time blocking routine («Workday», «Weekend»…): its blocks of the day and the weekdays it loads. Which routine a date loads: get_day. Returns it as stored.

anyOf.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png
Weekdays it loads every week (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday); they are taken from whichever routine had them. [] or null: no fixed day

weekdays.description: Weekdays it loads every week (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday); they are taken from whichever routine had them. [] or null: no fixed day

blocks.description: The whole list of blocks: with id updates that block, without id creates one, and a block left out is deleted. Blocks cannot overlap.

start_minute.description: Minutes from the routine's midnight (540 = 09:00; 1440+ = the next day)

icon.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png

task_id.description: The task the block is for; without it, title is required

ops.name: update_routine
ops.title: Update a routine
ops.description: Changes only the fields sent.

anyOf.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png
Weekdays it loads every week (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday); they are taken from whichever routine had them. [] or null: no fixed day

weekdays.description: Weekdays it loads every week (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday); they are taken from whichever routine had them. [] or null: no fixed day

blocks.description: The whole list of blocks: with id updates that block, without id creates one, and a block left out is deleted. Blocks cannot overlap.

start_minute.description: Minutes from the routine's midnight (540 = 09:00; 1440+ = the next day)

icon.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png

task_id.description: The task the block is for; without it, title is required

ops.name: delete_routine
ops.title: Delete a routine
ops.description: Deletes the routine and its blocks. Its weekdays become free and the dates that loaded it go back to the week.

ops.name: get_week
ops.title: The week
ops.description: Which routine each weekday loads, Monday first (free = no routine that day).

ops.name: set_weekday_routine
ops.title: Set a weekday's routine
ops.description: Every week, this weekday loads this routine (taken from the one that had it); null makes it a free day. The first time, the other six days go to the default routine.

ops.name: list_days
ops.title: Calendar
ops.description: The calendar from one date to another (at most 31 days). Each day says which routine it loads and why (source: date = set for that date, week = its weekday, default = no week set yet), the blocks that show, the ones resting (turned off that day or covered by a commitment) and its commitments.

ops.name: get_day
ops.title: One day
ops.description: Which routine a date loads and what that day looks like. Each day says which routine it loads and why (source: date = set for that date, week = its weekday, default = no week set yet), the blocks that show, the ones resting (turned off that day or covered by a commitment) and its commitments.

ops.name: set_day
ops.title: Change a day
ops.description: Changes what a date loads, like the app's «¿Qué rutina hoy?»: another routine that day only, or every week on that weekday (every_week), a free day, or blocks turned off that day. Picking what the week already gives clears the exception. Returns the day.

routine_id.description: Routine for that date; null = the week's one; left out = keep the current one

disabled_block_ids.description: Blocks of that day's routine turned off that day only (the whole list)

every_week.description: Also give that weekday to the routine (or free) every week

ops.name: reset_day
ops.title: Reset a day
ops.description: The date goes back to what its weekday loads. Its commitments stay. Returns the day.

ops.name: list_commitments
ops.title: List commitments
ops.description: Something fixed on one date («Dentist 15:00–16:00»), drawn over that day's routine. With skip_overlaps, the routine blocks it covers rest that day. Oldest change first; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

date.description: The user's local calendar date, yyyy-MM-dd

from.description: The user's local calendar date, yyyy-MM-dd

to.description: The user's local calendar date, yyyy-MM-dd

ops.name: get_commitment
ops.title: Get a commitment
ops.description: One commitment by id.

ops.name: create_commitment
ops.title: Create a commitment
ops.description: Something fixed on one date («Dentist 15:00–16:00»), drawn over that day's routine. With skip_overlaps, the routine blocks it covers rest that day. Returns it as stored.

date.description: The user's local calendar date, yyyy-MM-dd

anyOf.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png

end_time.description: HH:mm, after start_time; 24:00 at the latest (a commitment stays in its day)

skip_overlaps.description: The routine blocks it covers do not show that day (default true)

ops.name: update_commitment
ops.title: Update a commitment
ops.description: Changes only the fields sent.

date.description: The user's local calendar date, yyyy-MM-dd

anyOf.description: An emoji, or a built-in icon: assets/images/icons/<name>.png

end_time.description: HH:mm, after start_time; 24:00 at the latest (a commitment stays in its day)

skip_overlaps.description: The routine blocks it covers do not show that day (default true)

ops.name: delete_commitment
ops.title: Delete a commitment
ops.description: Removes the commitment; the blocks it covered show again.
